en: The Path of Discrimination 1,
Great Chapter 1.10.
The Discourse on the Drink of the Mandapa Hall.
“Monks, this holy life is a ‘consecrated drink.
When the Teacher is present, it is threefold as a consecration:
the consecration of the teaching when the Teacher is present, the consecration of the acceptance, and the consecration of the holy life.”
What is the essence of the teaching?

It is the announcing, the teaching, the making known, the establishing, the disclosing, the analyzing, and the elucidating of the Four Noble Truths; [likewise] of the four foundations of mindfulness...
of the four right efforts... [and so on].
of the four bases for psychic power … of the five faculties … of the five powers …
The explaining, teaching, proclaiming, establishing, revealing, analyzing, and making plain of the seven factors of enlightenment … of the noble eightfold path—
this is the elixir of the teaching.
What is the circle of recipients?
Monks, nuns, laymen, laywomen, gods, humans, or whoever else are capable of understanding—
this is the circle of recipients.
What is the essence of the holy life?
It is this very Noble Eightfold Path; that is to say:
right view, right intention, right speech, right action, right livelihood, right effort, right mindfulness, and right concentration.
This is the essence of the holy life.
The essence of resolve is the faculty of faith; lack of faith is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of lack of faith, one drinks the essence of resolve, which is the faculty of faith. Thus it is said.
It is a drink from a bowl.
The essence of exertion is the faculty of energy; sloth is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of sloth, one drinks the essence of exertion, which is the faculty of energy. Thus it is said.
The Maṇḍapeyya Sutta.
The essence of the service is the faculty of mindfulness; negligence is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of negligence, one drinks the essence of the service, which is the faculty of mindfulness. Thus it is said.
The extract to be drunk.
Non-distraction is the extract of the concentration faculty; agitation is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of agitation, one drinks the non-distraction extract of the concentration faculty—thus it is said.
The Essence of the Drinkable.
The essence of vision is the faculty of wisdom; ignorance is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of ignorance, one drinks the essence of vision, which is the faculty of wisdom. Thus it is said.
It is the drink to be drunk in the pavilion.
The power of faith is the pure essence of being unshakable by lack of faith; lack of faith is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of lack of faith, one drinks the pure essence of being unshakable by lack of faith through the power of faith. Thus it is said.
It is to be drunk like a medicinal extract.
The power of energy is the pure extract of being unshakable by indolence; indolence is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of indolence, one drinks the pure extract of being unshakable by indolence through the power of energy. Thus it is said.
The Maṇḍapeyya Sutta.
Regarding the "unshakeable essence" in heedlessness: the power of mindfulness is the essence, while heedlessness is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of heedlessness, one drinks the unshakeable essence of the power of mindfulness in regard to heedlessness—thus it is said.
It is a drink to be sipped.
The strength of concentration is the essence of imperturbability regarding restlessness, while restlessness is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of restlessness, one drinks the essence of imperturbability regarding restlessness through the strength of concentration. Thus it is said.
It is the "drinkable extract" (maṇḍapeyya).
The power of wisdom is the unshakable extract regarding ignorance, while ignorance is the dregs.
Having discarded ignorance as dregs, one drinks the unshakable extract regarding ignorance that is the power of wisdom—thus it is said.
The Maṇḍapeyya Sutta.
The essence of the service is the mindfulness enlightenment factor; negligence is the dregs.
Having discarded negligence as dregs, one drinks the essence of the service, which is the mindfulness enlightenment factor—thus it is said.
The extract to be drunk.
The investigation-of-phenomena factor of enlightenment is the extract; ignorance is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of ignorance, one drinks the extract of the investigation-of-phenomena factor of enlightenment—thus it is called "the extract to be drunk."
The drink of the pavilion.
The extract of exertion is the energy enlightenment factor; indolence is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of indolence, one drinks the extract of exertion of the energy enlightenment factor. Thus it is called "the drink of the pavilion."
The beverage to be drunk from the bowl.
The pervading essence is the joy factor of enlightenment; fever is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of fever, one drinks the pervading essence of the joy factor of enlightenment—thus it is said.
The essence to be drunk.
The tranquility factor of enlightenment is the essence, while coarseness is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of coarseness, one drinks the essence of the tranquility factor of enlightenment—thus it is called "the essence to be drunk."
The extract to be drunk.
The non-distraction extract is the concentration enlightenment factor; agitation is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of agitation, one drinks the non-distraction extract of the concentration enlightenment factor—thus it is called "the extract to be drunk."
It is a drink from the pavilion. The factor of enlightenment of equanimity is the extract of reflection, while non-reflection is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of non-reflection, one drinks the extract of reflection for the factor of enlightenment of equanimity—thus it is called "a drink from the pavilion."
The extract to be drunk.
Right view is the extract of vision, while wrong view is the dregs;
having discarded wrong view as dregs, one drinks the extract of vision that is right view—thus it is called "the extract to be drunk."
The essence to be drunk.
Right intention is the essence of application; wrong intention is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of wrong intention, one drinks the essence of application that is right intention—thus it is called "the essence to be drunk."
The essence to be swallowed.
Right speech is the essence to be swallowed; wrong speech is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of wrong speech, one drinks the essence to be swallowed that is right speech. Thus it is said.
It is like a medicinal decoction.
Right action is the pure essence arising from the decoction; wrong action is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of wrong action, one drinks the pure essence of right action that arises from the decoction. Thus it is called "the medicinal decoction."
It is to be drunk like a decoction.
Right livelihood is the pure essence, while wrong livelihood is the dregs;
having discarded the dregs of wrong livelihood, one drinks the pure essence of right livelihood. Thus it is said.
It is a beverage for the assembly.
Right effort is the refined extract of the assembly, while wrong effort is the dregs;
having discarded wrong effort as dregs, one drinks the refined extract of right effort—thus it is called a beverage for the assembly.
The Maṇḍapeyya Sutta.
Right mindfulness is the refined extract of service; wrong mindfulness is the dregs.
Having discarded wrong mindfulness as dregs, one drinks the refined extract of service that is right mindfulness. Thus it is said.
The essence to be drunk.
Right concentration is the essence of non-distraction; wrong concentration is the dregs.
Having discarded the dregs of wrong concentration, one drinks the essence of right concentration, which is non-distraction. Thus it is said.
The drinkable essence.
There is the solid residue, there is the drinkable portion, and there is the dregs.
The faculty of faith is the solid essence of resolve; lack of faith is the dregs.
Whatever there is therein of the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, and the flavor of liberation—this is the drink.
The exertion-elixir is the faculty of energy; indolence is the dregs.
Whatever there is therein of the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, and the flavor of liberation—
this is the "drink.
The presence of mindfulness as a faculty is the "sediment," while negligence is the "dregs."
Whatever there is therein of the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, and the flavor of liberation—this is the "drinkable.
Non-distraction as the essence is the faculty of concentration; restlessness is the dregs.
Whatever therein is the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, the flavor of liberation—this is the drink.
Vision is the essence, the faculty of wisdom; ignorance is the dregs.
Whatever therein is the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, the flavor of liberation—this is the "drinkable.
Unshakability in the absence of faith is the strength of faith; lack of faith is the dregs.
Whatever there is therein of the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, and the flavor of liberation—
this is the "drink.
Unshakability in the face of laziness is the "gruel," vigor is the "strength," and laziness is the "dregs."
Whatever therein is the taste of meaning, the taste of the Dhamma, the taste of liberation—this is the "drinkable.
The power of mindfulness is the unshakeable elixir in heedlessness; heedlessness is the dregs.
Whatever there is therein of the taste of meaning, the taste of the Dhamma, and the taste of liberation—
this is the "drinkable.
Unshakability regarding restlessness is the "concentrated strength," while restlessness is the "dregs."
Whatever there is therein of the essence of meaning, the essence of the Dhamma, and the essence of liberation—
this is the "drinkable.
The power of wisdom is the ferment of imperturbability regarding ignorance, while ignorance is the dregs.
Whatever there is therein of the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, the flavor of liberation—this is the drink.
The presence of the mindfulness enlightenment factor is the fermenting agent; negligence is the dregs.
Whatever there is therein of the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, and the flavor of liberation—this is the drink.
The essence is the elixir of investigation, which is the investigation-of-phenomena factor of enlightenment; ignorance is the dregs.
Whatever there is therein of the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, and the flavor of liberation— this is the "beverage.
The factor of enlightenment of energy, with exertion as its essence, has indolence as its dregs.
Whatever there is therein of the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, and the flavor of liberation—this is the drink.
The fermentation is the joy factor of enlightenment; fever is the dregs.
Whatever there is therein of the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, and the flavor of liberation—this is the drink.
The essence of tranquility is the tranquility enlightenment factor; coarseness is the dregs.
Whatever is the taste of meaning therein, the taste of the Dhamma, the taste of liberation—this is the "drinkable.
The non-distraction-essence is the concentration factor of enlightenment; agitation is the dregs.
Whatever there is therein of the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, and the flavor of liberation—this is the drink.
The refinement of reflective contemplation is the enlightenment factor of equanimity; lack of reflective contemplation is the dregs.
Whatever there is therein of the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, and the flavor of liberation—this is the drink.
Right view is the essence of vision; wrong view is the dregs.
Whatever therein is the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, the flavor of liberation—this is the drink.
Right intention is the fermenting agent of application; wrong intention is the dregs.
Whatever therein is the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, the flavor of liberation—this is the drink.
Right speech is the extract of the acquisition; wrong speech is the dregs.
Whatever there is therein of the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, and the flavor of liberation—
this is the "drinkable.
Right action is the "sediment of arising," while wrong action is the "dregs."
Whatever there is therein of the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, and the flavor of liberation—this is the "drinkable.
Purification is the essence, right livelihood is the essence; wrong livelihood is the dregs.
Whatever therein is the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, the flavor of liberation—this is the drink.
Right effort is the fermenting agent; wrong effort is the dregs.
Whatever therein is the taste of meaning, the taste of the Dhamma, the taste of liberation—this is the drink.
Right mindfulness is the fermenting agent; wrong mindfulness is the dregs.
Whatever taste of meaning, taste of the Dhamma, and taste of liberation there is—that is the "palatable.
Right concentration, which is the essence of non-distraction, is the "extract"; wrong concentration is the "dregs."
Whatever there is therein of the flavor of meaning, the flavor of the Dhamma, the flavor of liberation—
this is the "drink.
Right view is the "elixir" of seeing.
Right intention is the essence of directing;
right speech is the essence of encompassing;
right action is the essence of originating.
The essence of purification is right livelihood;
the essence of exertion is right effort;
the essence of establishment is right mindfulness.
Non-distraction is the essence of right concentration.
Establishment is the essence of the mindfulness enlightenment factor.
Investigation is the essence of the investigation-of-phenomena enlightenment factor.
The essence of exertion is the enlightenment factor of energy;
the essence of pervasion is the enlightenment factor of rapture;
the essence of tranquility is the enlightenment factor of tranquility.
The essence of non-distraction is the concentration enlightenment factor;
the essence of reflective discernment is the equanimity enlightenment factor;
the essence of unshakability by lack of faith is the faith power.
The essence of being unshakable by laziness is the power of energy;
the essence of being unshakable by negligence is the power of mindfulness;
the essence of being unshakable by restlessness is the power of concentration.
The essence of being unshakable by ignorance is the power of wisdom.
The essence of resolve is the faculty of faith.
The essence of exertion is the faculty of energy.
The essence of establishment is the faculty of mindfulness;
the essence of non-distraction is the faculty of concentration;
the essence of vision is the faculty of wisdom.
The faculties (indriya) are the essence in the sense of predominance; the powers (bala) are the essence in the sense of unshakability;

the factors of enlightenment (bojjhaṅga) are the essence in the sense of outlet; the path (magga) is the essence in the sense of cause; the foundations of mindfulness (satipaṭṭhāna) are the essence in the sense of establishment;

the right efforts (sammappadhāna) are the essence in the sense of exertion; the bases of psychic power (iddhipāda) are the essence in the sense of success; the truths (sacca) are the essence in the sense of suchness; [the jhānas] are the essence in the sense of non-distraction.
Calm is the essence; in the sense of contemplation, insight is the essence; in the sense of a single flavor, serenity and insight together are the essence;
in the sense of non-excess, the yoke of union is the essence; in the sense of restraint, purification of virtue is the essence; in the sense of non-distraction, purification of mind is the essence;
in the sense of seeing, purification of view is the essence; in the sense of liberation, deliverance is the essence.

In the sense of penetration, clear knowledge (*vijjā*) is the essence; in the sense of relinquishment, liberation (*vimutti*) is the essence; in the sense of eradication, the knowledge of destruction (*khaye ñāṇa*) is the essence;
in the sense of subsiding, the knowledge of non-arising (*anuppāde ñāṇa*) is the essence;

in the sense of being the root, zeal (*chanda*) is the essence; in the sense of origination, attention (*manasikāra*) is the essence; in the sense of convergence, contact (*phassa*) is the essence; in the sense of meeting place, feeling (*vedanā*) is the essence.
The essence is concentration in the sense of being preeminent; mindfulness is the essence in the sense of sovereignty; wisdom is the essence in the sense of being superior to that;
liberation is the essence in the sense of being the core; and Nibbāna, which plunges into the deathless, is the essence in the sense of being the ultimate goal.
The Discourse on the Essence of What Should Be Drunk is finished.
The Fourth Recitation Section.
The First Great Chapter.
Its Summary:
Knowledge, views, and consolations;
faculties, with liberation as the fifth;
destinies, kamma, and perversions.
"The path will be shown to you by Maṇḍa.
This was established by those who uphold the Nikāyas: "The peerless, first, most excellent, and supreme group."
